**Test image observations:**
- Single tomato leaf, predominantly green
- Fine scattered small dark spots/lesions across the leaf surface
- Leaf surface has a dull, slightly mottled texture
- No large concentric-ring lesions, no white powder, no yellowing/curling, no webbing visible
- Small pinpoint-to-small lesions distributed across the blade

**Comparison with Target_Spot reference:**
The reference collage shows tomato leaves with fine, scattered small dark spots on otherwise green leaves — very similar pattern to the test image. The lesions are small, dark, and distributed across the leaf surface, consistent with Target Spot's description of "dark brown pinpoint spots that enlarge with light brown to gray centers."

This doesn't match Spider Mites (no visible webbing, no bronzing stipple pattern), Early Blight (no large concentric-ring target lesions), or Septoria (no tan/gray centers with dark borders clearly visible at this scale).
